=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:462-571 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the runs list is cut off, the fallback window read uses 2 of the 3 reads allowed per heal, so a failing deciding run on a descendant commit needs `reads + need` = 2+2 = 4 > `MAX_READS_PER_HEAL` (3); the run is refused with `outcome=pending reason=read_budget` before any compare or jobs read happens.
  WHY: Every hourly tick gets the same inputs, so the stop repeats until the heal ages out of the 7-day window (`outside_window`); a fix that did not hold is never reopened as `recurred` on busy branches or scheduled workflows. The same stop happens when a `behind` compare uses read 3. google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite gave no severity; the others said MAJOR.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:481-549 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The one-day window re-read writes over the same `${runs_file}` that holds the open-ended list, so decisive runs after `mergedAt + 1 day` are thrown away; if the first 24 hours hold no completed decisive run, the scan logs `outcome=pending reason=no_completed_run`.
  WHY: The window is fixed, so every tick repeats the same empty result and the heal ages out unverified; the `no_completed_run` reason is also misleading because completed runs exist (total_count > 100).
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_verify.py:test_truncated_runs_list_reads_the_first_day_after_the_merge (~413-423 / 479-492) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The only test for the cut-off path puts every window run on MERGE_SHA; nothing covers a failing deciding run on DESC_SHA with compare `ahead`, or a window with no decisive run.
  WHY: CI passes while both paths stay pending forever. A test with `window = [_run(3, DESC_SHA, "failure", 20)]` and `compare={DESC_SHA: "ahead"}` would currently show `reason=read_budget`. The reviewers cite different line numbers for the same test function; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash gave no severity.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:486-489 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A failure of the window re-read logs the same `reason=runs_failed` as a failure of the open-ended list read, so operators cannot tell which call failed.
  WHY: Observability only; on an outage that hits only the window endpoint, operators may chase the wrong fix.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  EVIDENCE: For failing descendant runs on busy workflows, the script still runs out of read budget, logs `reason=read_budget`, and never reopens heals that recurred.
- requirement: "Make one GraphQL query for heal issues authored by the pipeline login: identify heal issues the same way existing heal scripts do (label or markers), CLOSED, closed in the last 7 days."
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh, candidate selection in `cmd_select`
  confidence=4

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:_verify_one, lines 481-483, budget gate at lines 503-509 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The cut-off fallback uses 2 of the 3 reads, so a failed or timed-out deciding run on a descendant commit needs 2+2=4 > 3 and logs `outcome=pending issue=<n> reason=read_budget` without a compare; the same happens when the oldest window run's compare returns `behind`.
  WHY: Nothing is written, and the same one-day window is re-read every hour until the heal is dropped as `outside_window`, so a fix that did not hold is never reopened as `recurred` on busy branches or scheduled workflows. Suggested fix: read only the one-day window when the list is cut off, or stop with a distinct reason.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:_verify_one, line 484, lines 547-549 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The window read writes over `runs_file` and throws away decisive runs on the first page of the original list; if the first 24h hold no completed decisive run, the script logs `no_completed_run`.
  WHY: The heal logs `pending reason=no_completed_run` every tick with a fixed window, the log line is misleading, and no fallback is possible because the budget is spent.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_verify.py:test_truncated_runs_list_reads_the_first_day_after_the_merge | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The window runs are all on MERGE_SHA; no test covers a failing DESC_SHA run with compare `ahead`, or a window with no decisive run.
  WHY: CI passes while those heals stay pending; a test with `runs_window={"ci.yml": [_run(3, DESC_SHA, "failure", 20)]}` and `compare={DESC_SHA: "ahead"}` would show `reason=read_budget` instead of `recurred`.
- HARDENING: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:_verify_one, line 486: log `reason=runs_failed window=true` on the window read and document it in agents.d/heal-verify.md (est. 2 lines); line 507: add a local `truncated=true|false` flag, set at line 482, to the read_budget log line (est. 3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1 (2 related items)
